items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Oh yeah, the tramont player? Yeah, I know him too. I know him.

ctx.x: I think Percy was a drummer for a while too, wasn't he? We haven't interviewed him. We interviewed the old man Willie and the young Willie too.
Yeah. Did you know his brother Earl? Did you know his brother Earl? Oh yeah, the tramont player? Yeah, I know him too. I know him.
What about those Milenburg things? Were they good fun?
